description: Which queues a RabbitMQ exchange delivers a message to, and why each binding matches or not: direct, topic (* and # words), fanout and headers (x-match all/any/all-with-x/any-with-x). Ported from RabbitMQ and calibrated against real 4.0.5 and 4.3.6 brokers (thousands of seeded cases, all equal). Unroutable means the message is dropped (or returned with mandatory). One difference: in headers, 1 and 1.0 are different values in RabbitMQ and equal here.

arguments.description: headers: the binding arguments, x-match included

bindingKey.description: direct/topic; ignored by fanout and headers

version.description: Broker line (default 4.3): from 4.3.5 a topic binding with more than two # is rejected

name: rabbit_route
